text: 53-year-old male. The patient has a 3-week history of fatigue, difficulty to concentrate, and dyspnea on exertion. He also experiences dizziness and digital pain that improves with cold. He has a long history of smoking.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Essential Thrombocythemia.

The patient is a 53-year-old male with thrombocytosis, low ferritin, and classic symptoms of microvascular disturbance including digital pain (acroparesthesia) that improves with cold and dyspnea. Given his smoking history and age, I suspect a myeloproliferative neoplasm. I need to confirm this with a bone marrow biopsy to rule out other causes of thrombocytosis.
